text:
erin: Quick sync — ACME wants a BYO-HSM POC. Key asks: full e2e rotation exercise, vendor attestation, and a pen-test window. Also need a cost delta for dedicated pool vs hosted. Who owns acceptance criteria and runbook?

michael: I can draft the POC plan. Suggested acceptance criteria (short): 1) customer-managed CMK import + successful sign/decrypt ops, 2) automated rotation succeeds w/ rollback test, 3) latency <100ms p95 for sign ops on dedicated pool, 4) audit logs routed to customer's SIEM. Will add steps.

carla: Security checklist: confirm HSM vendor FIPS 140-2 L3 or equivalent, provide attestation cert and HSM uptime SLA, and fill security questionnaire sections: key retention, escrow policy, who can initiate rotation. Also need timeline for pen test (customer expects a 2-week window).

tanya: Pricing note: BYO-HSM POC impacts pricing two ways — reserved capacity (monthly commit) if they want predictable throughput, and a one-time onboarding fee for key import/attestation. I estimated a ballpark: $8k onboarding + $3k/week for dedicated nodes during the POC. I'll refine with finance. :money_with_wings:

dave: (ACME) to confirm: we require a rotation dry-run with zero data loss and a defined rollback. Our risk team needs a signed key-escrow acknowledgement doc before we start. Also we'd like the pen-test to occur after the dry-run.

michael: Draft runbook snippet (for review):
```
POC Steps:
1) Provision dedicated pool in customer region
2) Customer imports CMK via HSM attestation flow
3) Run smoke: sign/verify on 1k reqs
4) Schedule rotation dry-run (2h window) + rollback path
5) Execute pen-test window (2 weeks)
6) Acceptance signoff from security + SRE
```
I'll attach the full checklist to the workspace.

carla: We'll need the vendor attestation before step 2. Also add: proof of key destruction process and KMS logs retention settings. I can pre-fill the security questionnaire answers for the common fields.

kevin: infra note — we can hit ~50ms p95 for sign ops on a dedicated A100 pool, but that assumes continuous warmup and correct batching. If ACME wants <10ms p95 we'll need a special config (higher cost). Also network egress for HSM ops will add ~10ms.

erin: Good context. Next actions: Michael — share POC runbook + SOW bullets by EOD. Tanya — firm up pricing and onboarding fee with finance. Carla — prepare sec-ques draft and outline escrow doc. Kevin — confirm latency guarantees and fallback behavior (model fallback vs degraded throughput).

michael: Will do. Also scheduling ask: customer prefers next Tue 10am PT for kickoff. Erin can you confirm?

erin: Confirmed. I'll send calendar invite and include the preflight checklist. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
